crossRefs.note: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in…
He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of…
About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in…
But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
